title: Implementation of the digitalisation vision for inland waterway transport as part of the European Green Deal
description: Implementation of the digitalisation vision for inland waterway transport as part of the European Green Deal. he Sustainable and Smart Mobility Strategy underlines the need to increase the use of more sustainable transport modes and indicated that the modal share of inland waterway transport and shortsea shipping should increase by 25% by 2030 and by 50% by 2050. To do so, the NAIADES III Communication indicates that digitalisation and automation are essential to reach these goals and to improve the sustainability, resilience, and competitiveness of inland waterway transport . The Sustainable and Smart Mobility Strategy requires that the transport sector’s emissions are reduced by 90% by 2050. To support achievement of these goals digitalisation is thereby seen as an indispensable driver for the modernisation of the entire transport system, making it seamless and more efficient, increasing the levels of safety, security, reliability, and comfort, whilst improving Europe’s global competitiveness through efficient and resilient logistics chains. One of the objectives set out in the NAIADES III Communication is to make inland waterway transport smarter, i.a. by further advancing the digitalization of the IWT sector. It is imperative for the IWT sector to keep up with digital developments to improve the sector’s competitiveness and ensure that it becomes an active part of broader multimodal chains. Further digitalisation can play a significant role in improving the efficiency and reliability of navigation and traffic management, better integrating inland waterway transport in logistics processes and multimodal chains and reducing the administrative burden and costs of complying with and enforcing legislation. The NAIADES III Communication foresees that the Commission will facilitate the elaboration of a holistic vision for the sector’s digitalisation with the contribution of the Digital Inland Navigation Area, NAIADES Expert Groups In order to meet these digitalisation challenges, the following (draft) vision for a digital inland waterway area by 2025 is put forward: By 2035, inland waterway transport in the European Union is a competitive, innovative connected, cyber secure and digital by default mode of transport which is fully harnessing the potential of digital technologies and emerging solutions, enabling seamless integration with other modes of transport as well as automation, by embracing the latest digital achievements and contributing to a better functioning of the Inland waterway single market. It will help overall time efficient, sustainable transport flows and support other modes to decongest.

title: SPARSE TRANSMIT KA-BAND ACTIVE PHASED ARRAYS FOR GROUND TERMINALS CONNECTED WITH SATELLITES IN DIFFERENT ORBITS (ARTES AT 7A.077)
description: The objective of this activity is to develop and test a Ka-band sparse active transmit antenna breadboard and associated beamforming network for ground terminals to be connected with satellites in orbits ranging from geostationary orbits to low earth orbit orbits. Targeted Improvements: - 25% reduction in the number of active controls.- 5% increase in the DC-to-RF power efficiency at antenna level, due to the reduced exploitation of amplitude tapering.- 15% reduction in the overall mass for the entire antenna.Description: Sparse arrays research and development has matured in the past years and some first non-European solutions are emerging on the market. Sparse arrays are attractive for active antenna with a large number of elements as the number of active controls can be reduced, DC-to-RF power efficiency can be improved, and overall mass can be lowered, with limited impact on the beamwidth. In addition, grating lobes and mutual coupling are reduced. Finally, irregular layouts may also be beneficial in order to accommodate, within thesame aperture, antennas with different target requirements. This activity will develop an active antenna breadboard including a beamforming network for a ground terminal that is able to operate with satellites in orbits ranging from geostationary to low earth orbits. Active phased-array antenna concepts exploiting sparse radiating elements layouts and sparse topologies for beamforming networks will be studied as well as suitable thermal management concepts. Key building blocks will be manufactured and tested, and a breadboard of a transmit sparse active antenna, including the most representative passive and active components, will be assembled and tested. The breadboard shall have switchable circular polarisation capability.

title: S2P S2-VS-06 VISDOMS-S PHASE A/B1
description: The procurement covers the VISDOMS-S Mission Phase A/B1. Based on the previous Space Based Optical Monitoring (SBOM) feasibility study, a mission concept using a small satellite and existing imager shall be further elaborated in a short Phase A. Suitable small platform candidates shall be further investigated in terms of its capacity and compliance towards the observational needs, the deorbiting requirements, and its capability to host the identified optical imager. The preliminary technical, engineering and quality assurance requirements for the Delta-Class mission shall be reviewed, agreed and consolidated as part of the Preliminary Requirements Review. The development approach shall be further elaborated with the objective to enable the establishment of the implementation and procurement plan. System optimisations based on previous flight experience that may lead to an improvement of the mission performance and its robustness by enhancing the existing equipment and optical imager may be considered for further elaboration during Phase B1.The Phase B1 industrial system study shall produce a preliminary design of the space and ground segment that shall include all elements for the mission definition, the spacecraft and the optical imager and the ground segment. The satellite design shall be matured, and a detailed accommodation study of the optical imager shall be performed. The design of the optical imager and potential modifications that may be required shall be addressed including the detector selection, readout electronics and the control and data processing unit. The technical requirements specifications of all major units shall be established, and the system requirements shall be consolidated and verified as far as possible by analysis. The study shall produce the necessary documentation for the System Requirements Review and confirm that the review objectives are achieved.

title: Germany – Laboratory, optical and precision equipments (excl. glasses) – Computer Tomograph
description: Das LIB betreibt am Standort Bonn derzeit drei µ-Computer-Tomographen. Das LIB scannt verschiedenste organische Proben, hauptsächlich Tiere, die teilweise gefärbt, in Flüssigkeiten, luftgetrocknet oder anderweitig fixiert sind. Es werden so gut wie niemals zwei gleiche Proben oder Arten gescannt. Daher werden an das neue Gerät extreme Anforderungen in Bezug auf Vielseitigkeit und Einstellungsmöglichkeiten durch den Nutzer gestellt. Zwei der vorhandenen Geräte sind in die Jahre gekommen und werden demnächst ausgemustert, bevor ihre Quellen ganz versagen. Dabei handelt es sich um ein Gerät mit Flatfield Panel, das Proben bis zu 10 cm Durchmesser und ca. 16 cm Länge scannen kann. Typische Anwendungen am LIB für dieses Gerät sind Kopfscans von Schlangen, Fischen oder Aufnahmen ganzer Eidechsen. Das Zweite Gerät verfügt über einen CCD Detektor mit 4000 x 4000 Pixeln, der hochauflösende Scans von kleinen Proben wie z.B. Insekten oder Köpfe von kleinen Fischen (Rice-Fische) ermöglicht. Beide Geräte werden am LIB intensiv genutzt und beide Größen- bzw. Anforderungsspektren werden auch wieder benötigt.

title: Acquisition de tests psycho-techniques informatisés. | Verwerving van geautomatiseerde psychotechnische tests.
description: Brusafe est l’école régionale des métiers de la sécurité, de la prévention et du secours. Elle se compose de 4 écoles (ERIP, CFPB, IFAMU, ERAP) qui dispensent les formations de base et continuées aux acteurs de la chaine SPS, Polices, Pompiers, Ambulancier-secouristes, Agents de la prévention urbaine. Au sein de l’école, un Centre d’Orientation au Recrutement (le COR) est au service de toute personne qui souhaite intégrer ses métiers et qui désire un accompagnement pour la préparation des épreuves de sélection. Ces accompagnements peuvent aller de la préformation (quelques mois de remise à niveau) à un accompagnement individuel ciblé sur les besoins de la personne. Pour aider ces futurs candidats aux métiers du SPS à évaluer leurs besoins en préformation ou en accompagnement, le COR souhaite disposer de tests informatisés disponibles en ligne. Ces tests, qui nous serviront de « Diagnostic », doivent évaluer les compétences cognitives et générales des candidats qui souhaitent postuler à la Police intégrée ou en tant que Sapeur-pompier au sein du SIAMU. L’enjeu est celui de réduire le taux d’échec aux épreuves de sélection en offrant l’opportunité aux candidats de s’y préparer par le développement des compétences nécessaires aux métiers et par la compréhension des enjeux de la fonction. L’accès aux épreuves de sélection pour la fonction d’agent de police n’est pas conditionné par des exigences en matière de diplôme, tout comme pour le poste de sapeur-pompier. Cependant, le niveau des épreuves correspond à un niveau scolaire de 6e secondaire de l’enseignement technique. L’accès aux épreuves de sélection pour la fonction d’inspecteur de police exige, quant à lui un certificat d’études secondaires supérieures (CESS). Notons que les épreuves soumises aux candidats agents et aux inspecteurs de police sont identiques en termes de contenu. Cependant, les critères d’évaluation et les attentes sont revus à la hausse dans le deuxième cas de figure. Les épreuves de sélection police comportent entre autres : • Epreuve d’aptitudes cognitives (Raisonnement numérique, abstrait et traitement de l’information) • Epreuve de personnalité Les épreuves du CAF sapeur-pompier comportent entre autres : • Epreuve de Langue (compréhension à la lecture - rapidité nécessaire) • Epreuve de Mathématique (problèmes logiques) • Epreuve de Sciences (dimension, géométrie, électricité, physique) ex. Exercices de conversion (nb de litres en m³) • Epreuve de Logique (ex : Selor, suites logiques à compléter) • Epreuve de Visualisation spatiale | Brusafe is de Gewestelijke School voor de Veiligheids-, Preventie- en Hulpdienstberoepen Ze bestaat uit 4 scholen (GIP, IODMH, OCBB en GSOB) die basis- en voortgezette opleidingen verstrekken aan actoren in de VPH-keten, politie, brandweer, ambulanciers en stedelijke preventieagenten. Binnen de school staat een Oriëntatiecentrum voor Rekrutering (OR) ten dienste van iedereen die tot de beroepen van de school wil toetreden en hulp wenst bij de voorbereiding op de selectieproeven. Deze steun kan gaan van vooropleiding (een paar maanden bijscholing) tot individuele begeleiding die speciaal gericht is op de noden van de persoon. Om deze toekomstige kandidaten voor VPH-beroepen te helpen bij het beoordelen van hun behoeften op het gebied van vooropleiding of begeleiding, wil het OR beschikken over geautomatiseerde tests die online beschikbaar zijn. Deze tests, die wij als "diagnostisch" zullen gebruiken, moeten de cognitieve en algemene vaardigheden beoordelen van kandidaten die willen solliciteren bij de geïntegreerde politie of als brandweerman binnen de DBDMH. De uitdaging bestaat erin om het percentage mislukkingen voor de selectieproeven te doen dalen door de kandidaten de mogelijkheid te bieden zich erop voor te bereiden via de ontwikkeling van de vaardigheden die noodzakelijk zijn voor de beroepen en via het begrijpen van de uitdagingen van de functie. De toegang tot de selectieproeven voor de functie van politieagent is niet afhankelijk van diploma-eisen. Dat geldt ook voor de functie van brandweerman. Het niveau van de proeven komt echter overeen met het schoolniveau van het 6de secundair technisch onderwijs. Voor de toegang tot de selectieproeven voor de functie van politie-inspecteur is een diploma secundair onderwijs vereist. Wij wijzen erop dat de proeven die aan de kandidaat-agenten en kandidaat-inspecteurs van politie worden voorgelegd, inhoudelijk gelijk zijn. In het tweede geval worden de beoordelingscriteria en de verwachtingen echter naar boven bijgesteld. De selectieproeven voor de politie omvatten onder meer: • Cognitieve vaardigheidstest (numeriek, abstract en informatieverwerkend redeneren) • Persoonlijkheidsproef De FGA-proeven voor de brandweer omvatten onder andere: • Taalproef (begrijpend lezen - snelheid vereist) • Wiskundeproef (logische problemen) • Wetenschapsproef (dimensie, meetkunde, elektriciteit, natuurkunde) b.v. Omrekeningsoefeningen (aantal liter naar m³) • Logicapoef (bijv.: Selor, aan te vullen logische reeksen) • Ruimtelijke visualisatieproef Gecomputeriseerde cognitieve vaardigheidstests | Tests d'aptitudes cognitives informatisés

title: VERY-LOW MASS-FLOW RATE FLOW CONTROLLER FOR FINE CONTROL FOR GRAVIMETRY MISSIONS - EXPRO PLUS
description: This ITT will allow the Agency to identify the most promising technology for fine mass-flow control of Electric Propulsion systems in order to enhance the efficiency, resolution and minimum thrust step required for Earth Observation gravimetry missions. This activity will assess and benchmark the currently available technologies at concept level and boost the Technology Readiness Level (TRL) to a level of = 3 (analytical and experimental critical function and/or characteristic proof-of-concept), with the ultimate objective to minimise development risks before entering detailed design, qualification, production and commercialisation phases.The targetof this activity is to design, manufacture, assemble and test a Breadboard Model (BBM) of a flow-rate controller that complies withthe defined requirements. To achieve this goal, several tasks are defined as intermediary objectives which shall be sequentially achieved:-To assess the system/AOCS needs for representative missions, and to extract the relevant propulsion requirements (functional, performance and robustness) -To flow-down the propulsion requirements to mass flow control specification -To survey of available flow control technologies for space and non-space applications-To perform a preliminary benchmark of suitable technologies and selection of most promising technology-To perform numerical simulations and analysis to support design and testing-To design, manufacture and test a prototype-To perform a coupling test with representative thruster (TBC of test facility and thruster to be provided as agency undertaking) for performance verification-To assess the performance improvement with the new development-To define the development roadmap

The required features of future reusable space-tugs and propellant depots will be analysed and described.-(Task 2) For each of the above categories, the contractor will then describe the technical building-blocks that shall be matured. -(Task 3) The contractor will then draft a concept of PoC-3demonstrations objectives and content that would mature the most promising building blocks above and perform their In-Orbit Demonstration.
